title: Failure-triage evaluation boundaries
description: Run from the checkout. Set TRIAGE_PROOF_OUT to a new directory. All transport fixtures are explicitly non-live and cannot enable the pilot.

proof.intent: Evaluation rejects invalid usage and transport without live provider calls.

v2.intent: Evaluation keeps control data private and enforces live selection guards.

pilot-evidence.intent: Only immutable verified pilot evidence satisfies the evaluation prerequisite.

navigation-workflow.cmd: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json node --import tsx scripts/failure-triage/workflow-navigation-cli.mts seal-advice scripts/failure-triage/navigation-cases.v1.json "$TRIAGE_PROOF_OUT-navigation-plan.json" && node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(require("node:fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")); if (p.hash!=="1577ac63d9bb38817f7642b0ef2b27301723e399708338025cd7948227300ccf" || p.cases.length!==8) process.exit(1)' "$TRIAGE_PROOF_OUT-navigation-plan.json" && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=services/gateway/tsconfig.json node --import tsx scripts/failure-triage/prove-navigation-workflow.mts "$TRIAGE_PROOF_OUT-navigation-workflow"
navigation-workflow.intent: Navigation evaluation binds sealed plans and scoring to the same session.
